verses.text: Haxo yik ix yilan heb' chonhab' israel to a winhaj Moisés chi' hanheja' max emxul-laj winh b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ha tiknaik, ko gana to tza b'o juntzanhok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés, winh ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, manh kojtakok tas ix ik'an winh, xchi heb' chonhab' chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Aarón chi' t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik, molb'ejekkot masanil k'een uchikin nab'a oro yik heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' yik heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, tzeyik'ankot t'ayin, xchi winh.
Masanil anima ix yik'el yuchikin, ix yik'ankot heb' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix schaanek' winh, ix yak'an ulax k'een winh t'a skal te' k'ak', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol jun smoldeal, ix b'o jun yechel jun kelem wakax. Ix ochnhej ijan winh swach' b'oan jun yechel wakax chi'. Ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil: --Ex ketchonhab' israel, a jun ko diosal tik ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Aarón chi', ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh t'a yichanh jun yechel wakax chi', te chaanh ix yal winh: --Ha k'ik'an skak'och junok niwan q'uinh t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Haxo ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u, ix smolb'an sb'a anima smasanil, ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi' ix em k'ojjab' heb', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e b'ulnaj heb' schanhalwi yet' sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh sdiosal chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ixik, emanhxi yujto a heb' a chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto, toxo ix sjuel sb'a heb'.

Yelxo wal t'a elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a tas ix wala'. T'a elanhchamel ix sb'o jun yechel kelem wakax heb', syak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'ay. Syak'an silab' heb', syalan heb': Ex ketchonhab' israel, a wal jun ko diosal tik ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.
Toxo ix wila'' to a juntzanh anima tik, yelxo wal pit spensar heb'.
Ha tiknaik manhxo ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', skot wal wowal t'a juntzanh anima tik. Ol in satel heb' smasanil, anhej het'ok ol in b'o jun niwan nación yet' heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo winhaj Moisés chi', ix och ijan winh sk'anan niwank'olal t'a Jehová sDiosal yuj heb' schonhab', ix yalan winh: --Mamin Jehová, ¿tas wal yuj skot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh a chonhab' to a ach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' ipalil?

¿Tas wal yuj ol a cha ach yal heb' aj Egipto chukal? Ol am yal heb' icha tik: Tob'an chuk spensar Dios t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yik'el heb' t'a tik, sb'at smilancham heb' t'a jolomtak witz, satjiel heb' yuj t'a sat lum lum tik, xcham heb'. Yuj chi' komonok max te kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb', mokab' ak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Komonok tza nakot heb' a chekab', haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha loknak a b'i ak'annak a ti' t'a heb', alannak icha tik: Ol wik'chaanh he b'isul yet' eyuninal. Lajan ol aj sb'isul heb' icha k'een k'anal t'a satcha'anh. Hanheja' jun lum lum tik, toxo ix wala' to ol wak' t'a eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, xa chinak t'a heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' ix snaan Jehová to manhxo ol satel-laj schonhab' chi'.
Ix meltzajemta winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz chi', yet'nakxo chab' pachanh k'een winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il yuj Jehová, t'a schab'il pak'anh k'een.
Ha wal Jehová ixb'o'an k'een k'een chi' schab'il, ix stz'ib'anoch letra chi' t'a k'een.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Josué yel yaw heb' anima, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha wal skab'an yel yaw heb' anima chi', icha wal to ayoch owal t'a yol campamento, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha juntzanh aw tz'och skab' chi', manh awok yik tzalajk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar junok owal, manh awokpax yik kusk'olal yik tz'ak'ji ganar anima yuj heb' ajk'ool, palta b'it tz'och swab'i, xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a slak'anil campamento chi', ix yilanoch jun yechel kelem wakax chi' winh, haxo heb' anima wan schanhalwi heb'. Ix te kot yowal winh, ix syumanel k'een k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il chi' winh, yuj chi' ix pojb'at k'een t'a yich witz chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at stzak'anelta jun yechel wakax chi' winh, ix syumanoch winh t'a skal k'ak'. Ixlajwi chi' ix smak'anpoj winh, chok'xonhej ix aji, ix yak'anem winh t'a skal ha ha', ix schekan winh yuk' heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': --¿Tas yuj ach montaj yuj juntzanh anima tik ix a kuchb'an heb' sk'ulan jun niwan chukal tik? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Aarón chi': --Mamin, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, ojtak wal sik'lab'il to a jun chonhab' tik, sgananhej heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' ix halan t'ayin: B'o junok ko diosal tzonh kuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, ma chekel tas ix ik'an winh, max jaxlaj winh, xchi heb' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan t'a heb': Machtak ex ay k'een oro t'ayex, ma k'een uchikin, ik'ekeli, tzeyik'ankoti, xin chi t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'ayin, ix wak'an ulax t'a kal k'ak', haxo ix aji ix komon elta jun yechel wakax tik, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Moisés chi' to a heb' anima chi', b'ekanxonhej sk'ol heb' yak'an q'uixwelal sb'a t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', haxo winhaj Aarón chi' maj skachoch waan jab'ok heb' winh.

Yuj wal chi' ix och tek'tek' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a sti' campamento chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik a mach syal sk'ol syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, kotokab' t'a in tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Masanil heb' yetlevitail winh, ix snitzkot sb'a heb' t'a stz'ey winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax winh t'a heb': --Ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex to junjun ex tzeyik'b'at eyespada, tzex b'at t'a campamento, tzex ek' t'a kaltak mantiado, tze milancham heb' eyuk'tak, heb' eyamigo yet' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' winh levita ix yak' winh. Yuj chi', ay am oxeok mil anima ix smilcham heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik ix eyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ina to a ex ix he milcham eyuninal yet' eyuk'tak. Yuj wal chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' anima: --Te niwan he mul ix ochi. Ha tiknaik tik tzin b'atxi t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová. Hata' ol in lolon yet'ok, talaj ol yak' lajwok he mul chi' t'a eyib'anh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz b'aj ayek' Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Wal yel Mamin, te niwan smul jun chonhab' tik ix och t'a ichanh, ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' oro yik syak'em sb'a heb' t'ay.

Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' lajwok smul heb' chi'. Tato max ak' niwank'olal smul heb' chi' jun, tza suksat in b'i t'a yol ch'anh libro b'aj tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb' to ikxo yaji, xchi winh t'a Jehová.
Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'och smul t'ayin, haton heb' chi' tzin suksat sb'i t'a yol ch'anh libro chi'.
Yuj chi' ixik, tzik'anb'at heb' chonhab' chi' t'a jun lugar ix wal t'ayach. Ha jun wángel ol b'ab'laj eyuuj, palta ol k'och sk'ual yik ol wak'anoch syaelal heb' anima tik yuj smul, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan ilya to smilwaj t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab' israel chi', yujto ix yak'och sb'a heb' sb'oan jun yechel wakax, haton jun ix sb'o winhaj Aarón chi'.
